# SentinelIQ Project Instructions

The governing project specification is [the SentinelIQ Master Build Prompt](../docs/master-build-prompt.md). Read and follow it for all SentinelIQ project work; treat it as the primary source for product scope, architecture, safety, and gate sequencing.

Work on one implementation gate at a time. Stop at each gate and wait for explicit authorization before beginning the next. Do not claim tests, integrations, or validation succeeded unless they were actually run and observed.

If the master prompt conflicts with higher-priority instructions or applicable safety requirements, follow those higher-priority requirements and explain the conflict. Keep the master prompt itself intact; update it only when explicitly asked.
